map.比例-积分-微分控制律输出。: Output of the proportional-integral-derivative control law.
map.积分项消除稳态误差。: The integral term removes the steady state error.
map.闭环控制输出计算。: Computing the closed loop control output.
map.P/I/D 三项合成。: Combining the P, I and D terms.
map.ki=kd=0 → u=2，稳态有静差；加 I 消除、D 抑制超调。: With ki = kd = 0 the output is u = 2 and a steady state offset remains; adding I removes it and D damps the overshoot.
map.误差积分累积；ep 为上一拍误差，用于 D 项差分 (e−ep)/dt。: It is the accumulated error integral, while ep is the previous sample error used for the D term difference (e - ep)/dt.
map.大误差长期积分易饱和，需抗积分饱和限幅。: A large error integrated over a long time saturates easily, so anti-windup clamping is needed.
